canonicalGoalAtReview.title: Experimentelle Untersuchungen fachgerecht dokumentieren
canonicalGoalAtReview.description: Die lernende Person kann Beobachtungen, Messwerte, Auswertungsschritte und Ergebnisse einer physikalischen Untersuchung in einem strukturierten Protokoll oder einer fachtypischen Darstellung nachvollziehbar dokumentieren.
canonicalGoalAtReview.descriptionEn: The learner can document observations, measurements, evaluation steps, and results of a physical investigation in a structured report or subject-specific representation.

Die lernende Person kann Beobachtungen, Messwerte, Auswertungsschritte und Ergebnisse einer physikalischen Untersuchung in einem strukturierten Protokoll oder einer fachtypischen Darstellung nachvollziehbar dokumentieren.

reviewMethod: Both complete language versions, solutions and all scoring cores manually read; independent numerical and vector calculations plus exhaustive rubric enumeration.
contentReview: Each report independently documents question, setup, method, observations, raw measurements, own calculations and bounded conclusions.
Supplied material is explicitly didactic. Documentation competence does not falsely claim a personally performed experiment.
The two cases require different validity decisions; all original observations and invalid/uncertain records must remain traceable.

independentCalculations.invalidRecords: Pilot P remains documented but is not a repeat. B4 has unknown count and cannot be silently converted to a period.

scopeReview: Only the actual covered atom is a prerequisite. Task course tags equal the covered competence course tags. No irrelevant ordinary prerequisite is added.
limitations: No actual learner execution or human trial has occurred.
This is candidate content review; final release metadata, source scopes and actual projections are checked separately.
